levels.surface: يحيى بن عبد الله بن سالم

notes: «بمثل حديثهما وقال في آخره» is a wording remark on the two earlier reports and is left out
«أنه سمع» refers to Abu al-Zubayr, who heard the Companion; it is not a back reference
the Companion Ibn al-Zubayr is the speaker of the saying and ends the chain
